published_title: All Your Base Are Belong To Us
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Solo337''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.
description: A remake of the deck that won me year 2000 states, and it just happened to do it again. ISB Scum the way it was meant to be.
cards: Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
notes: Won the 2001 Alabama State Championship: the post says he 'won States again this year' and signs 'Al State champ- again' (he also won Alabama States in 2000 with an earlier version of this ISB Scum deck, and DragonCon 2000).
The posted list differs from the one played at States: there he played Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders instead of Resistance and Endor Occupation instead of Power Of The Hutt.

Starting cards as marked (s): ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents (posted 'ISB/Empire's Bad Men', listed last under 'Objective'), Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, Power Of The Hutt, No Bargain and There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement ('TINT/OE'); these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'Coruscant (s)' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), the system ISB Operations deploys.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace x3' dested 3 x Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (the exterior site), kept at the posted quantity; the Audience Chamber and Lower Passages are listed separately, and the strategy drains at three Jabba's Palace sites.

Posted 'Jabba' dested the Special Edition Jabba (the strategy says 'SE Jabba'); 'ECC Iggy' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'ECC 4-LOM' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'EPP Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Xizor' Prince Xizor; '5-D6-RA-7' 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix).

Posted 'Ghhk/TRWES' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Evader/Monnok' Evader & Monnok; 'Twi-lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Nevar Yalnl' Nevar Yalnal; 'Scum' Scum And Villainy; 'Hell 2 Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay.
Ships: 'Bossk in ship' Bossk In Hound's Tooth, 'Zuckess in ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, 'Fett in ship' Boba Fett In Slave I.
Secret Plans and Resistance were Effects in 2001, not Defensive Shields.
The Interrupts section is headed '(16)' but lists 15 cards; the deck totals 60.
player_note: The post says that at the 2001 Alabama State Championship he played Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders instead of Resistance and Endor Occupation instead of Power Of The Hutt (metagaming against Watch Your Step); the list here is the post's recommended version.
